query:
SELECT c.id, c.name, c.cardNumber, ph.price, ph.soldAt, ph.createdAt 
FROM cards c 
LEFT JOIN priceHistory ph ON c.id = ph.cardId 
WHERE c.cardNumber LIKE '%SM-P 288%' 
AND ph.source = 'snkrdunk' 
AND ph.grade = 'PSA10' 
ORDER BY ph.soldAt DESC 
LIMIT 5;
